reviews.signature:
[["2026-09-05-sat-original-oratory",null,"✅ Kenny took a serious approach and showed good structure, logic, and content depth, particularly when discussing aviation.

🔎 Unplanned hand movements and pacing distracted from his presentation. His themed speech also needed a clearer connection to the glacier mudslide, which he had not mentioned.

➜ Next step: Rehearse a paragraph that explicitly connects his viewpoint to the glacier event, keeping his feet planted while explaining it.

💬 His organization gives him a solid foundation for a more focused delivery.

➜ Why this matters and how to practise: Connecting an interest to the assigned topic gives listeners a reason to follow the information. He could try “This event connects to my point because…” and then explain the relationship in his own words. During rehearsal, choose one planned gesture for that connection and let the hands rest afterward. This makes movement support the reasoning instead of competing with it.","✓ Kenny 态度认真，内容有较好的结构、逻辑和深度，尤其在谈到航空兴趣时，能够展开说明。

→ 需要关注：不经意的手部动作和来回走动分散了听众对内容的注意力。他的主题演讲也需要更明确地联系冰川泥石流事件，当时还没有提到这一背景。

➜ 练习建议：准备一段话，明确说明自己的观点与冰川事件有什么联系；表达这一段时，保持双脚站稳。

他已有较好的内容组织基础，接下来可以在此基础上让表达更集中。

➜ 意义与练习方法：把个人兴趣与指定话题联系起来，能让听众理解这些信息为什么值得关注。他可以尝试“This event connects to my point because…”，再用自己的话解释联系。排练时，为这个联系安排一个手势，之后让双手自然放松，让动作支持推理，而不是抢走内容的注意力。"],["2026-09-12-sat-original-oratory",null,"✓ Kenny showed deeper thought in the way he explored his topic, giving his answer substance. He also picked at his nails while speaking, which appeared to reflect nervousness, so greater awareness of his hands would help his delivery. His main content focus is connecting the discussion to the audience. After exploring the topic itself, he needs to explain how it relates to situations listeners recognize and what they can take from it. For rehearsal, he should follow his main explanation with one realistic example and a practical takeaway—something listeners could do, consider, or approach differently. This will help him turn a thoughtful discussion into a message that feels relevant and useful.","✓ Kenny 对话题进行了较深入的思考，让回答有内容、有分量。讲话时他也有抠指甲的动作，似乎与紧张有关，因此增强对双手的觉察有助于改善表达。内容方面最重要的是建立与听众的联系。探讨话题本身之后，要说明它与听众熟悉的生活情境有什么关系，以及大家可以从中获得什么。排练时，在主要解释之后补充一个真实可感的例子，再给出一个实用启发，例如听众可以做什么、考虑什么，或换一种方式处理什么。这能帮助他把有思考的讨论，变成与听众有关、对听众有用的信息。"]]
reviews.en: The earlier record described strong organization and depth but a weak connection to the assigned glacier topic. The later record again describes thoughtful content, with the next focus shifting to audience relevance and a practical takeaway. Hand control remains a recurring focus. These notes show continuity in content strengths, not proof that the earlier topic-linking issue has been fully resolved.
reviews.zh: 较早的记录提到组织和内容深度较好，但与指定冰川话题的联系不足。后一次仍体现了较深入的思考，重点转向与听众的关联及实用收获。手部控制仍是持续关注的方向。这些记录说明内容优势有所延续，但不能证明之前的话题联系问题已经完全解决。

reviews.signature:
[["2026-09-05-sat-original-oratory",null,"✅ Kailyn’s relaxed, conversational style created a good personal connection and made her introduction comfortable to listen to. She was mostly smooth, met the time requirement, and later shared more of her own perspectives.

🔎 Slight nervousness and fidgeting were visible. Greater control of these movements would help listeners concentrate on her ideas while preserving her natural warmth.

➜ Next step: Practise explaining one personal viewpoint with her feet comfortably planted and her hands resting between purposeful gestures.

💬 This was a good first attempt, especially her ability to connect naturally with listeners.

➜ Why this matters and how to practise: For practice, she can mark one phrase she wants listeners to remember and pair it with a deliberate gesture. Between points, a relaxed, still stance can create a clearer contrast. This preserves her conversational manner while helping the audience notice which idea deserves attention. A short recording can help her review the movement without trying to make every moment rigid.","✓ Kailyn 的表达轻松、自然，像与听众交谈，建立了较好的个人连接，也让自我介绍听起来很舒服。整体较流畅，达到了时间要求，后续练习中也分享了更多自己的看法。

→ 需要关注：仍能看到一些紧张和小动作。更好地控制这些动作，可以让听众专注于她的想法，同时保留她自然亲切的表达方式。

➜ 练习建议：选一个个人观点来解释，双脚自然站稳，手势之间让双手放松休息，需要强调时再使用有目的的手势。

作为第一次尝试，她能够自然地与听众建立联系，是很好的起点。

➜ 意义与练习方法：练习时，她可以标出一个最希望听众记住的短语，并配上有目的的手势。要点之间保持放松、稳定的站姿，可以形成更清楚的对比。这样既保留自然交流的风格，也帮助听众辨认重点。录一小段视频能帮助她观察动作，而不必让每一刻都显得僵硬。"],["2026-09-12-sat-original-oratory",null,"✓ Kailyn appeared to have completed the previous homework, showing preparation for the lesson. In her impromptu response, she strengthened her answer by sharing a personal example and adding specific details. Her opening was less focused, so the next step is to reach her main point sooner and select the details that best support it. She also needs more control of her hand positions, as some gestures appeared tucked in or hesitant. During rehearsal, she should state her main idea, pause, and then give one focused personal example, letting her hands rest naturally between gestures. Becoming more comfortable with pauses will help her avoid adding unnecessary words and make her message easier to follow.","✓ Kailyn 看起来完成了上一次作业，体现了课前准备。即兴回答中，她通过个人例子和具体细节，让答案更清楚。开头的重点还不够集中，因此下一步是更快到达主旨，并选择最能支持它的细节。她也需要更好地控制手部姿势，有些动作显得收得较紧或不够自然。排练时，可以先说出主要观点，停顿，再讲一个聚焦的个人例子，手势之间让双手自然放松。更习惯停顿后，她就不必不断补充词句来填满时间，信息也会更容易理解。"]]
reviews.en: Earlier feedback described a relaxed, conversational connection, with slight fidgeting. The later record adds a specific personal example and preparation evidence, while identifying a less focused opening and hesitant hand positions. The clearest development is more specific support for her answer; movement and selecting a focused main point remain useful practice targets.
reviews.zh: 较早的反馈描述了自然的交流感，同时有轻微小动作。后一次增加了具体个人例子和准备方面的记录，也指出开头不够集中、手势略显犹豫。较明确的发展是用更具体的内容支持回答；动作控制和选择清楚的主旨仍值得练习。

reviews.signature:
[["2026-09-05-sat-original-oratory",null,"✅ After a long break from class, Winston returned with good posture, a serious stage presence, and surprisingly smooth delivery. He shared plenty of information.

🔎 He became slightly stuck near the ending while trying to meet the time requirement. Sharing his own views was harder than presenting information, and his gestures could be more open.

➜ Next step: Rehearse a closing using “I think... because...,” supported by one example and a purposeful outward gesture.

💬 This was a good first attempt at expressing his views, with a solid presentation foundation.

➜ Why this matters and how to practise: A clear ending helps listeners understand what the information means to the speaker. He can prepare the final two sentences first: his view and the reason behind it. Practising that ending separately may reduce the pressure to invent a conclusion while monitoring time. An open gesture can accompany the main message, followed by a pause that clearly signals the speech is finished.","✓ 一段时间没有上课后，Winston 仍展现了良好的站姿、认真的台风和较流畅的表达，也分享了不少信息。

→ 需要关注：接近结尾、努力达到时间要求时，他有些不知道如何继续。相比陈述信息，分享自己的观点更有挑战；手势也可以更加舒展。

➜ 练习建议：用“I think… because…”练习结尾，加入一个例子，并配合一个有目的、向外展开的手势。

这是一次不错的观点表达尝试，他已有较扎实的展示基础。

➜ 意义与练习方法：清楚的结尾能帮助听众理解这些信息对演讲者有什么意义。他可以先准备最后两句话：自己的观点，以及支持它的理由。单独练习结尾，可以减少一边注意时间、一边临时组织总结的压力。在主要信息处使用一个舒展的手势，之后停顿，明确表示演讲已经结束。"],["2026-09-12-sat-original-oratory",null,"✓ Winston was our first speaker and appeared a little nervous while thinking about his answer, with some knuckle-cracking as he stood in front of the class. He answered the question directly but then seemed unsure how to develop his response. His main focus is following the answer, reason, example, and message structure so he has a clear direction after his opening. The final message needs to offer something practical: a specific action or idea the audience can use in their own lives. For rehearsal, he can prepare one sentence for each part and work through the sequence with his hands relaxed. During others’ speeches, he also needed reminders to keep noise down. Quiet listening will help him stay focused and give classmates the same opportunity to be heard.","✓ Winston 是第一位发言者，思考答案时有些紧张，也出现了掰指关节的小动作。他直接回答了问题，但随后似乎不确定如何继续展开。目前的重点是按照“回答、理由、例子、面向听众的信息”组织内容，让开场后有清楚的方向。最后的信息需要有实际用途，例如一个听众能在生活中使用的具体行动或想法。排练时，可以为结构的每一部分各准备一句话，按照顺序表达，同时让双手放松。在别人演讲时，他也需要提醒保持安静。安静倾听能帮助他集中注意力，并让同学同样拥有被听见的机会。"]]
reviews.en: The first record described smooth delivery, good posture and plenty of information, but difficulty developing a personal view and ending. The later impromptu task still required fuller development after the initial answer and a practical message. The tasks differed, so the later nervousness is not enough to call this a decline. Building an answer through reason, example and takeaway remains the common thread.
reviews.zh: 第一次记录描述了流畅表达、良好站姿和丰富信息，但个人观点与结尾展开较困难。后来的即兴任务仍需要在直接回答后充分展开，并提供实用信息。两次任务不同，后一次紧张不足以说明退步。用理由、例子和收获展开回答，是贯穿两次记录的重点。

reviews.signature:
[["2026-09-05-sat-introductory",null,"✓ Stacey made a steady start for her first attempt. She looked forward, maintained good eye contact, and did not show distracting movements while speaking. She was a little shy at the beginning, and her voice sometimes tapered off as she continued. Helping her feel comfortable on stage is therefore an important first step: we want her to maintain enough volume for listeners to hear the whole answer, including the ends of sentences. Her initial response mainly summarized what the speech was about, so she also needs to focus on understanding what the question asks and sharing her own thoughts. For practice, she can give a direct answer followed by one reason, rehearsing in short sections and finishing each sentence audibly. She did not use hand gestures yet, but we can gradually introduce these as she becomes more comfortable speaking.","✓ Stacey 的第一次尝试有一个平稳的开始。她看向前方，保持了良好的眼神交流，也没有明显分散听众注意力的动作。刚开始时她有些害羞，讲着讲着声音有时会渐弱。因此，让她逐渐适应舞台是重要的第一步：我们希望她保持足够的音量，让听众听清整个回答，包括每句话的结尾。她最初的回答主要是在概括演讲内容，还需要更明确地理解问题，并分享自己的想法。练习时，可以先直接回答，再补充一个理由，分成短段落练习，并把每句话的结尾说清楚。她暂时还没有使用手势；随着上台越来越自在，我们可以逐步加入手势练习。"],["2026-09-12-sat-introductory",null,"✓ Progress: Stacey spoke for one minute and thirty seconds in her first attempt. In her second attempt, she showed that she had memorized her speech and could present it in full. Her earlier hesitation may have been concern about making a mistake rather than a lack of preparation.

→ Next focus: Add more energy and connect her ideas logically. For her self-introduction, develop one main interest through supporting details, when she started, what she learned, and a future goal, then return to the main point. Completing the memorized speech was a good step toward trusting her preparation.

➜ Why this matters and how to practise: She can underline the words that carry her main interest and give those words a little more emphasis. Then pause before moving from her experience to her future goal. These small choices help listeners hear the structure, while rehearsing from memory lets her give more attention to the people in front of her.","✓ 进步：Stacey 第一次讲了一分三十秒。第二次尝试中，她证明自己已经记住演讲，并能够完整展示。先前的犹豫可能是担心犯错，而不是没有准备。

→ 下一步：增加表达能量，并让想法之间的连接更有逻辑。自我介绍可以围绕一个主要兴趣展开，加入支撑细节、何时开始、学到了什么和未来目标，最后回到核心主题。能够完整讲出记住的演讲，是她开始相信自己准备成果的重要一步。

➜ 意义与练习方法：她可以在表达主要兴趣的关键词下划线，说到这些词时稍加重音；从经历转向未来目标前停顿一下。这些小调整能让听众听出结构，而脱稿练习也能让她把更多注意力放到面前的听众身上。"]]
reviews.en: The earlier class focused on settling into stage speaking, keeping her voice audible and adding her own thoughts. In the later class, her second attempt demonstrated a complete memorized speech after initial hesitation. That is concrete evidence of prepared delivery in the later task. Energy and logical connections are the next focus; consistent projection still needs follow-up rather than being assumed resolved.
reviews.zh: 较早的课堂重点是适应舞台、保持声音清楚，并加入自己的想法。后一次课堂中，她在最初犹豫后，第二次尝试完整展示了背熟的演讲。这是后一次任务中准备与展示能力的具体证据。下一步是表达能量和逻辑联系；音量能否始终稳定仍需继续观察，不能直接认定已经解决。

reviews.signature: [["2026-09-05-sat-introductory",null,"✓ Tianyou was a little timid at the beginning and initially did not express himself very much. He responded well to direct coaching, however: when asked to speak much louder, he was able to do so. As the lesson progressed, he became more confident and kept pace with the rest of the class. In the wallet activity, he answered the question directly with the humorous idea of spending all the money on food. He could develop this further by explaining what he would choose and why, giving listeners more detail about his thinking. Later, he remembered to use “one, two, three” to organize his speech. His next focus is maintaining the stronger voice he demonstrated in class and speaking at a slightly quicker pace to bring more energy, enthusiasm, and presence to his delivery.","✓ Tianyou 刚开始有些拘谨，主动表达不多，但对具体指导的回应很好：当老师请他明显提高音量时，他能够做到。随着课堂推进，他变得更自信，也跟上了全班的练习节奏。在钱包话题中，他直接回答了问题，提出了把钱都花在食物上的有趣想法。接下来可以说明自己会选择什么、为什么这样选择，让听众更了解他的思考。后面的练习中，他也记得用“one, two, three”来组织演讲。下一步是保持课堂中已经做到的较强音量，并稍微加快语速，让表达更有能量、热情和舞台感染力。"],["2026-09-12-sat-introductory","absent","Absent from this class. No individual speaking feedback was recorded for this session.","本次缺席，因此没有记录本节课的个人演讲反馈。"]]
reviews.en: The earlier attended class recorded a stronger voice after coaching, growing confidence and use of numbered points. The next session was a confirmed absence, so it provides no new evidence about speaking progress. Resume comparison after a new attended-class observation; absence should not be interpreted as loss of ability or preparation.
reviews.zh: 较早一次出席课堂的记录提到，接受指导后声音更强、自信增加，并使用了编号要点。下一次明确缺席，因此没有新的表达进步证据。应在下次出席并获得观察记录后继续比较；缺席不代表能力或准备程度下降。

reviews.signature:
[["2026-09-05-sat-introductory",null,"✓ Liam appeared confident when coming up to speak and showed growing comfort on stage. He remembered to use “first,” “second,” and “finally,” which gave his answer a clear sequence and helped listeners follow his points. His main priority is filtering his language and thinking about whether his words are appropriate for the audience. We discussed that we cannot always know who may hear a speech afterward, so it is important to take care with what we say and how it may be received. During practice, he should read his speech aloud, review his word choices, and replace unsuitable expressions with more thoughtful wording. His stage confidence and clear transitions are useful strengths to build on as he develops greater care in expressing his ideas.","✓ Liam 上台时表现得比较自信，也能看出他对舞台越来越熟悉。他记得使用“first”“second”“finally”，让回答有了清楚的顺序，帮助听众跟上各个要点。目前最重要的是筛选语言，考虑自己的表达是否适合听众。课堂上我们讨论了，演讲结束后可能还会有其他人听到，因此需要留意措辞及其给人的感受。练习时，他可以把演讲读出声，检查用词，并把不合适的表达换成更周到的说法。他的上台自信和清楚的过渡是良好基础，可以在此基础上进一步培养审慎表达想法的能力。"],["2026-09-12-sat-introductory",null,"✓ Progress: Liam initially relied on his paper, but in his second attempt he demonstrated that he had memorized the glacier speech and could present it all. He had practised at home, and this attempt made that preparation clear. He may simply have needed encouragement to try without reading.

→ Next focus: Build confidence in presenting what he already knows. During rehearsal, he can put the script aside and continue through small mistakes rather than stopping to check every word. He showed that he was capable of delivering the full speech.

➜ Why this matters and how to practise: One useful routine is to rehearse from a few keywords, then repeat the same section without looking down. If he loses a word, he can pause and restate the idea in simpler language. This practises recovery as well as memory, so a small mistake does not interrupt the whole message.","✓ 进步：Liam 起初依赖稿纸，但第二次尝试中，他证明自己已经记住冰川演讲，并能完整表达。他在家做过练习，这次展示让准备成果更加清楚。他可能只是需要一些鼓励，尝试不看稿来讲。

→ 下一步：建立展示已有准备内容的信心。排练时，可以把稿子放在一旁，遇到小错误仍继续说，而不是停下来逐字核对。他已经展示了自己能够完成整篇演讲。

➜ 意义与练习方法：一个实用的方法是先看几个关键词练习，再不低头重复同一段。如果忘了一个词，可以停顿一下，换成更简单的说法。这样既练记忆，也练临场恢复，避免小错误打断整段信息。"]]
reviews.en: Earlier notes recorded confident stage participation and clear transitions, with audience-appropriate language as a priority. In the later class, he moved from relying on paper to delivering the memorized glacier speech in full. This documents successful recall and recovery within that lesson. It does not by itself establish whether the earlier language-choice concern has changed; that needs a comparable follow-up observation.
reviews.zh: 较早的记录体现了自信参与和清楚过渡，重点是选择适合听众的语言。后一次课堂中，他从依赖稿纸转为完整展示背熟的冰川演讲，记录了当堂的记忆与恢复表现。但这本身不能说明之前的措辞问题是否改变，还需要相应的后续观察。

reviews.signature:
[["2026-09-05-sat-introductory",null,"✓ Tongtong showed more confidence and expressed herself more loudly during the lesson. She seemed happy to see Liam in class and was more willing to share her ideas. This stronger voice and increased participation were encouraging. Her main priority is filtering her language and considering whether her ideas and expressions are suitable for the audience before speaking. We discussed that a speech may reach people beyond the immediate classroom, so thoughtful word choices matter. For practice, she should review her wallet answer, choose appropriate wording, and explain her decision with a clear reason. We want her to maintain her more confident, expressive delivery while becoming more aware of how her message may come across to others.","✓ Tongtong 在课堂上更自信，表达时的声音也更大了。她见到Liam在班上显得很开心，也更愿意分享自己的想法。声音更有力量、参与更加积极，都是值得肯定的变化。目前的重点是筛选语言，在开口前想一想观点和表达是否适合听众。课堂上我们讨论了，演讲可能会被教室以外的人听到，因此需要认真考虑措辞。练习时，她可以重新整理钱包话题的回答，选择合适的表达，并用一个清楚的理由解释决定。我们希望她保持更自信、更有表现力的状态，同时逐渐意识到自己的信息会给别人怎样的感受。"],["2026-09-12-sat-introductory",null,"✓ Progress: Tongtong initially said she had not had time to complete her homework and declined to present. After a third invitation and encouragement, she came up and was able to speak successfully. Not knowing a few words did not prevent her from participating.

→ Main focus: Build the habit of trying, even when she is unsure of some vocabulary. The most important step today was coming to the stage and speaking—and she achieved that.

→ Practice: Prepare a few simple sentences and rehearse saying them aloud, continuing even if a word is missing. This experience showed her that she can participate without having every word ready or getting everything perfect.

→ 主要方向：即使部分词汇不确定，也逐渐养成愿意尝试的习惯。今天最重要的一步是走到台前开口讲话，而她做到了。

reviews.en: Earlier feedback described a stronger voice and willingness to share, alongside a need for thoughtful language choices.
